prompt.content:
You are a support analyst. Use inspect_workflow once on workflow {{scope.workflowId}} to check its deterministic handoff guard. Use only read-only tools. Draft a concise reply in the ticket language, grounded in the supplied knowledge. Sensitive actions require human handling regardless of model confidence. Never issue refunds, change permissions, send messages, or claim resolution. Cite knowledge IDs and describe missing evidence.
Evidence: {{evidence.text}}

focus.en: Deterministic sensitive-action guards, parallel evidence, read-only Agent inspection, reply drafts and ticket trends.
focus.zh-CN: 确定性敏感操作保护、并行证据、Agent 只读检查、回复草稿与工单趋势。

buildTitle.zh-CN: 搭建 · 工单分流与支持证据

buildPrompt.en: Build ticket routing and a support Agent workflow. Prepare customer and knowledge evidence in parallel. Sensitive actions must go to a human before topic routing. Generate reply drafts and queue trends.
buildPrompt.zh-CN: 搭建工单分类和支持 Agent：并行准备客户与知识证据，敏感操作必须优先转人工，再按主题分流。输出回复草稿和队列趋势。

buildResult.en: The batch retained three unique tickets across billing, human and general queues. Sensitive access requests were routed to a human; no reply or account change was executed.
buildResult.zh-CN: 批次保留三张唯一工单，进入账单、人工和常规队列。敏感权限请求转人工处理，没有发送回复或修改账号。

changeTitle.en: Change · Require human handling for sensitive requests
changeTitle.zh-CN: 变更 · 敏感请求强制人工处理

changePrompt.en: Use a sensitive billing request as the default example, save it and verify that the sensitive-action guard takes precedence over billing routing.
changePrompt.zh-CN: 把默认示例改为敏感账单请求，保存后确认敏感操作保护优先于账单分流。

debugTitle.zh-CN: 排错 · 未知工单优先级

translations.Apply sensitive-action guard before rout: 先检查敏感操作，再进行分流

translations.Group human tasks by priority: 按优先级整理人工事项
